A '''subspace comm transfer satellite''' was a device used by ground based individuals to keep in contact with other [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Typically, a subspace comm transfer [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] would be deployed in orbit of the planet, allowing individuals on the ground to use it to transmit messages from surface based communications equipment to other planets.

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] science team [[MS-133]] deployed a subspace comm transfer satellite in orbit of [[Aaris III]] during their expedition to the planet.
